sections.Profile:
"Blackwater 100" is a 1988 pinball machine by Bally, designed by Dennis Nordman with artwork by Tony Ramunni. The game has a unique motocross racing theme and features five flippers, three ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Its distinctive playfield design mimics a dirt bike race, complete with jumps and obstacles.
